Application Data.NAME: Bright Futures Educational Supplies
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Bright Futures Ln, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-5678
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bright Futures Educational Supplies specializes in providing high-quality educational materials and school supplies, including textbooks, art supplies, stationery, and learning aids. Our retail store is dedicated to supporting the educational community by offering a wide selection of products tailored for students and educators. We maintain a well-organized inventory, focusing on popular items while ensuring stock levels are manageable to minimize risk. Our physical store is equipped with standard security measures, including locked display cases and adequate lighting, to protect our merchandise from theft. We conduct limited online sales, constituting less than 25% of our total revenue, to further mitigate cyber risks. Our commitment to providing exceptional service and quality products makes us a trusted resource for educational needs in the community.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past three years, Bright Futures Educational Supplies experienced a theft incident on March 5, 2022, where educational materials valued at $1,500 were stolen from the store. The claim was processed, and the business received compensation. The current status is closed. Additionally, on June 12, 2021, there was minor water damage due to a plumbing issue, costing $1,000 to repair. This incident has been resolved, and the status is also closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: S&G Class 1, Grade A, UL Listed Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: We have a security system in place, including a central station alarm and a safe on the premises to protect our inventory. Additionally, we employ watchpersons during operating hours to ensure the safety of our store and staff.
